text:
alex: Heads-up — we're cutting `v1.12` branch at 10:00 UTC. If you need a late merge, post PR number + short rationale here.

ben: Hi — PR #5489 fixes a regression in the quantized kernel that causes a tokenizer mismatch for long contexts. Failing unit: tests/runtime/kv_cache.test. I'd like a late merge if possible. Changes are small (5 files), cherry-pick candidate: `git cherry-pick 3f2a9b8`.

maria: @ben can you confirm it doesn't change model weights or any API schema? Also need a changelog note. Please paste the failing log.

ben: log paste:
```
AssertionError: expected 1024 == received 1023 at kv_cache.c:412
Stack trace: runtime/kv_cache.c:412 -> encoder.c:201 -> tokenization.c:88
```
This only adjusts buffer indexing; no schema changes. Changelog snippet: "Fix KV cache off-by-one causing tokenizer mismatch for long context".

sophia: @maria ping — does this qualify for a late merge? QA is short; I can run a quick smoke on staging in ~15m.

maria: Outline the risk and rollback plan and let's see smoke results. If smoke fails we revert. Also need a runtime team review from @alex.

alex: Reviewing now. Quick note: please add a regression test so it doesn't slip again. If ben can add one-liner test I'll approve.

ben: added test in #5489, pushed. `git show --name-only` shows `tests/kv_cache_offby1.test` included.

deploy-bot: Freeze enforced: merges to `release/v1.12` are blocked until override is granted by Release Lead. Use `/freeze-exception request`.

ben: Submitted `/freeze-exception request --pr=5489 --reason="critical regression for quantized serving"`

maria: Received. Triage: low surface area, small diff, test added, smoke ok (thanks @sophia). Granting exception — @release-admin please approve override. :thumbsup: 

release-admin: Approved override for PR #5489. Proceed to merge and note in changelog.

alex: Merged and backported to `main` and `release/v1.12`. Tags pushed. CI is green. Please update the release notes with the changelog snippet and mark as a patch.

sophia: Verified staging smoke passed. Good to go. :party: 

ben: Thanks all — will follow up with a short postmortem tomorrow on root cause and blocking test to prevent recurrence.
